display.purpose: Hero headline only. Kanit 800 italic uppercase.

headline.purpose: Every section h2. Kanit 800 italic uppercase.

title.purpose: h3 in light slabs, Track Red. Kanit 800 italic uppercase.

label.purpose: Buttons and nav links, Barlow bold uppercase.

shadows.name: hero-text-shadow
shadows.purpose: Keeps the hero headline readable where it crosses the photo. The only shadow in the system.

motion.name: open
motion.value: 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0)
motion.purpose: The hero windows open once, left to right. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

angles.name: cut
angles.purpose: Jaw angle for windows, buttons, plates, frames, countdown cells, roster chips.

angles.name: rise
angles.purpose: Section top-edge cut; about 3 to 4 degrees across the viewport, a shallow echo of 18deg.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: White parallelogram with Track Red label; the single call to action on red or ink ground.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 56px; background: #ffffff; color: #d4232b; font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; clip-path: polygon(18px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 18px) 100%, 0 100%); transition: background-color .15s, color .15s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #16090a; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Sticky Discord Button
components.description: Warm Ink parallelogram pinned to the bottom of phone screens.
components.html: Join our Discord
components.css: .ds-sticky { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 48px; background: #16090a; color: #ffffff; font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; clip-path: polygon(18px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 18px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-sticky:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d4232b; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Countdown Cell
components.description: Skewed Track Red cell with upright numerals; four in a row for the next-event timer.
components.css: .ds-cell { display: inline-block; width: 140px; padding: 32px 4px; background: #d4232b; color: #ffffff; text-align: center; transform: skewX(-18deg); } .ds-cell-in { transform: skewX(18deg); } .ds-num { margin: 0; font-family: Kanit, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-style: italic; font-size: 4.5rem; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-unit { margin: 8px 0 0; font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; }

components.name: Roster Name
components.description: Skewed Warm Ink chip carrying a player's in-game name in display type.
components.css: .ds-name { display: inline-block; background: #16090a; color: #ffffff; transform: skewX(-18deg); } .ds-name-in { display: block; padding: 12px 32px; font-family: Kanit, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 2.5rem; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.02em; transform: skewX(18deg); }

components.name: Result Plate
components.description: Track Red skewed placement plate beside event name and date.
components.css: .ds-result { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #16090a; } .ds-place { background: #d4232b; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; transform: skewX(-18deg); } .ds-place-in { display: block; transform: skewX(18deg); font-family: Kanit, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 3rem; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Caption Plate
components.description: Warm Ink cut plate under the hero photo with title, caption and carousel controls.
components.html:
Season opener

The squad after the final.
components.css: .ds-plate { width: 34rem; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 24px 64px; background: #16090a; color: #ffffff; clip-path: polygon(50px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 50px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-plate-title { margin: 0; font-family: Kanit, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-plate-cap { margin: 4px 0 12px; font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-ctl-btn { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; background: none; color: #ffffff; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .15s; } .ds-ctl-btn:hover { border-color: #ffffff; } .ds-ctl-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Slanted Photo Frame
components.description: 16:9 photo cut at the jaw angle, with title and caption below.
components.css: .ds-photo { margin: 0; width: 320px; color: #ffffff; } .ds-photo-img { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: #6b0f12; clip-path: polygon(18% 0, 100% 0, 82% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-photo-title { margin: 16px 0 0; font-family: Kanit, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Red Field Slab
components.description: Section on the logo gradient with a shallow diagonal top cut and a Headline.
components.css: .ds-field { --rise: 56px; padding: calc(var(--rise) + 4rem) 24px calc(var(--rise) + 3rem); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6b0f12 0%, #b3151b 45%, #e4181e 100%); color: #ffffff; clip-path: polygon(0 var(--rise), 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-h2 { margin: 0; font-family: Kanit, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 6rem); line-height: .95; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

narrative.overview:
The system is the UTM logo's own construction, scaled up to a page. A red field takes the logo's gradient. White knife slashes cut through it at 18 degrees, the angle of the dragon's jaw. Type is heavy, uppercase, italic and tightly set, leaning with the same shear. Everything that is a box is a parallelogram, and the hero photo is only visible through slashes cut at that angle.

The page alternates the red field, warm-ink slabs and white slabs. Horizontal section cuts are a shallow echo (about 3 to 4 degrees) of the 18 degree angle used on windows, buttons, plates and countdown cells. A dark-red ghost dragon sits behind each section and faint code-drawn textures keep flat color alive. One authored motion moment: the hero cuts open once.
keyCharacteristics: Red field with white slashes; red is carried by large areas, not sprinkled.
One shear angle, 18 degrees (--cut), applied to every box and cut edge.
Sheared heavy italic display type, uppercase, negative tracking.
Zero border radius anywhere; silhouettes are parallelograms and diagonals.
Flat: no box shadows; depth comes from overlap, ghost layer and texture.
Textures are faint and always behind content.

rules.name: The One Gradient Rule
rules.body: The red field is a 135 degree gradient, Crimson 0%, Cut Red 45%, Flame Red 100%. It appears only as .field, and only on the hero, Moments and Join. Never use it on a card or a button.

rules.name: The Warm Ink Rule
rules.body: Dark ground is #16090a, never #000. White-on-red text uses Track Red or darker; text sits on Flame Red only at large sizes.

rules.name: The Inverted Button Rule
rules.body: Buttons are white with Track Red text on red or ink ground, and flip to ink or red on hover. A red button on a red field is never used.

rules.name: The Lean Rule
rules.body: Display type is never upright and never lowercase. The only upright text is Barlow body copy.

rules.name: The Unskew Rule
rules.body: When a box is skewed (.skew), its content is wrapped in .unskew so the type is italic by choice, not distorted by the box.

rules.name: The Behind-Only Rule
rules.body: Ghost and texture layers are ::before/::after at z-index -1 inside an isolated stacking context. They never sit over content and never receive pointer events.

dos: Do shear every box at 18 degrees (--cut, .cut-btn, .cut-plate, .slant, .skew) and keep section cuts shallow at about 3 to 4 degrees.
Do set display type in Kanit 800 or 700 italic uppercase with -0.02em tracking.
Do keep ground to three states: red field, Warm Ink (#16090a), white.
Do use .unskew on content inside any .skew box.
Do keep ghost and texture layers behind content, faint and non-interactive.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: the windows reveal and smooth scroll turn off, and the carousel does not autoplay.
donts: Don't round corners; there is no radius in this system.
Don't add box shadows or glows for depth.
Don't use pure black or gray neutrals; the darks are reddish ink.
Don't steepen section cuts to 18 degrees or flatten buttons and plates to horizontal.
Don't put the red field gradient on small components such as cards, chips or buttons.
Don't use upright or lowercase display type.
